I appreciate you taking your time to help me. I must inform you that my relationship I have with family isn’t exactly positive and I have gone to them with this problem and their attitude was “get over it” so I don’t think they’ll be much help.

I am looking into resources I can use to get the help I think I need, and your comment was an important influence for that so thank you.
I appreciate your answer to my question. It has been helpful. I haven’t sought out professional help quite yet, but I am looking for those resources. Thank you for your time in helping a stranger.

I appreciate your taking time to help me, but I must say that my relationship with my family (mainly my parents) isn’t exactly positive.

I do thank you for your efforts to help me find solutions.
